span.p:
Drive a real steering wheel through aggressive /
drift trajectories from research motion planners —
repeatably, safely, with evidence of what happened

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Several computers + links
can each fail silently

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Trajectories must be
captured, replayed, compared

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A crash or lost link must
never leave torque applied

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cascaded control: motor FOC 20 kHz ⊃
Teensy PD+I 1 kHz ⊃ PC setpoints 200 Hz

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Health tree A–F: every link and
subsystem has a node with a reason

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Recordings with lineage: motion → playbacks,
metrics + health + events stored together

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Firmware-owned safety: trips, slew & gain
ramps, heartbeat/switch gating, REST on loss

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Auto end-stop calibration +
software zero at exact centre

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Calibrate → Enable → Free-spin
→ record hand motion

Play back / run generator
→ compare metrics
